newsitem.title: FRANCE: Schneider says first 2 mths '97 in line.
newsitem.headline: Schneider says first 2 mths '97 in line.

text.p: French industrial group Schneider SA said in a statement that the trends observed during 1996 were confirmed in the first two months of 1997.
"In France, the economic recovery has not yet emerged, particularly in the area of capital investment," it said.
It added that in Europe and North America, the trends observed during the last quarter of 1996 were continuing at a comparable pace as in Germany and Northern Europe.
"As for the rest of the world, product sales are growing at a sustained pace in South America, Africa and Asia," it said.
Schneider earlier reported a 61.6 percent increase in net attributable profit to 1.32 billion francs, from 817 million in 1995.
It raised its dividend to five francs per share net, from four francs.
